items.title: OpenAI confirms ChatGPT is down as logins and signups fail
items.description: ChatGPT is experiencing a major outage, and users are unable to sign in, create accounts, or load chats, including previous conversations. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-32754: Foxit
items.description: A CVSS score 3.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Anonymous' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-08-19, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-12-17 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
